products.name: Chroma
products.note: Open-source embedding database; local-first; lightweight RAG; self-hosted option

profile_text.body:
Chroma is an open-source search infrastructure company for AI, accessible at trychroma.com. The company describes itself as providing security, compliance, education, and an operational model suited to enterprises, built on an Apache 2.0 architecture.

The company's primary product, also called Chroma, is an open-source embedding database designed to be local-first and lightweight, with support for retrieval-augmented generation and a self-hosted deployment option. It is categorized as a coding and developer tool.
